title: Greaseabloo
html_source:
A pun on Grace Bloom, grace being pronounced like grease in Ireland (Gifford & Seidman).

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: It’s ‘grease’ that’s pronounced like ‘grace’, not the other way round. Irish English pronunciation of ‘grease’ is as if unaltered by the Great Vowel Shift.
